title: Vite
description: Next-generation frontend tooling with instant hot module replacement.

data.text: Vite (French for 'quick') is a next-generation build tool that provides instant server start via native ES modules and lightning-fast Hot Module Replacement (HMR). It uses Rollup for production builds.

data.title: Starting a Vite Project
data.content: Create and start a Vite React project.
data.code:
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

terms.definition: ES Modules served natively by the browser during development, no bundling needed.
Hot Module Replacement — updates modules without a full page reload during development.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Vite provides instant dev server startup
data.takeaway: Vite has become the default tooling choice for modern frontend projects.
